title: Geniza persistent fruit with typed juice-bulk and conditional override
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, NOT SELECTED. The complete cached Judaeo-Arabic fruit source supports a finite constructor in which one named fruit persists through base description, sour/sweet/unripe conditional effects, and a typed juice-versus-body split. Known component order supplies the predicate frame, the whole-form residual selects the extension kind, and entry context carries the named subject and current subreferent. This is not a target gloss or a prefix-code claim.

source.work: PGP40129 restricted generated Judaeo-Arabic fruit paragraph source
source.scope: Complete generated source family: PEACH, APRICOT and POMEGRANATE heads, base predicates, SOUR/SWEET/UNRIPE conditional extensions, JUICE_BODY comparison, and BEFORE_AFTER paired condition.
source.source_limit: The packet is a bounded source-owned constructive grammar; its generated products are not a historical Voynich decipherment and do not bind target words.

atoms_and_roles.head: HEAD(h) opens one persistent fruit referent h and cannot silently replace it inside a clause.
atoms_and_roles.known_parts: A productive ordered part frame fills PREDICATE and EFFECT slots; the exact whole residual chooses one licensed extension operator.
atoms_and_roles.context: ENTRY(h, state) carries h and the current referent view (WHOLE, JUICE, or BODY) into the next clause; paragraph reset closes it.
atoms_and_roles.residual: EXT(sour|sweet|unripe|juice_body|before_after) is the only selector for extension kind; no nearest-noun repair is allowed.

operators: COND(h,c,e) -> CLAUSE(h,WHOLE,IF(c,e)) and leaves h open
WHEN(h,t,e) -> CLAUSE(h,WHOLE,IF(t,e)) and preserves h for the paired alternative
RETURN(h) -> WHOLE(h), only after a written close/return operator
complete_source_trace: HEAD(PEACH) ; SPLIT(PEACH) ; COMPARE(PEACH,e_juice,e_body) ; WHEN(PEACH,BEFORE_FOOD,e_before) ; WHEN(PEACH,AFTER_FOOD,e_after) ; RETURN(PEACH)
constructor.consequence: The same fruit identity survives every conditional branch, while JUICE_BODY changes only the active subreferent. A later whole-fruit clause must refer to PEACH rather than silently creating a second fruit; a juice effect cannot be copied onto the bulk unless the written comparison explicitly licenses it.
constructor.rival: R-RESET treats each extension as a fresh unnamed fruit and R-COLLAPSE treats juice and body as one referent. It predicts that a later return cannot restore the earlier fruit and that a juice-only effect automatically applies to the whole fruit.
constructor.falsifier: Reject if a complete source-owned continuation requires a conditional extension to replace the fruit head, if JUICE_BODY has no distinct juice/body argument, or if BEFORE_AFTER changes the subject rather than only the condition/effect. On target material the proposal would require an already owned repeated frame and context boundary; absent that binding it remains untestable.
